assignmentHtml.task:
全面调查 Kids Diana Show 的 YouTube 频道。查明以下事项：

  1. 稳定频道 ID 及规范 URL。
  2. 运营方：Diana 和 Sergey（俄罗斯创作者）。如存在公司结构，请说明。
  3. 频道创建日期，以及目前仍公开的最早上传视频。
  4. 运营地点及频道显示的国家（最初在俄罗斯，现在在美国？）。
  5. 使用的语言（该频道以英语为主）。
  6. 主要内容类别（儿童视频博客／玩耍）。
  7. 内容供应模式。
  8. 代表性系列。提供直接来源 URL。
assignmentHtml.context: 根据 Communitrics 于 2026 年 9 月 2 日的快照，Kids Diana Show 排名第 7 名，历史累计观看量约为 126B（1260 亿）次。需要可核实的事实，并附来源链接。
assignmentHtml.expected_output: 一份关于 Kids Diana Show 的结构化资料，包含全部要求的字段，每个字段均附来源 URL。

answerHtml:
Kids Diana Show — Structured Dossier

(1) Stable Channel ID & Canonical URL

  • Channel ID: UCk8GzjMOrta8yxDcKfylJYw
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCk8GzjMOrta8yxDcKfylJYw
  • Handle: @kidsdianashow
    Sources: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCk8GzjMOrta8yxDcKfylJYw; https://socialblade.com/youtube/handle/kidsdianashow

(2) Operators & Company Structure

  • Operated by the Kidisyuk family: mother Olena Kidisyuk (story ideas, co-creator), father Volodymyr Kidisyuk (finances/legal), starring daughter Eva Diana Kidisyuk and son Roma Kidisyuk.
  • No formal LLC/trade name is publicly documented; business contact is dianaromabiz@gmail.com.
  • Since May 2020, the family partners with Pocket.Watch (Culver City, CA), a children's media company founded in 2017 by Chris Williams and Albie Hecht, backed by ViacomCBS, Greycroft, UTA, and others. The deal created the 'Love, Diana — The Princess of Play' franchise.
  • In-house production: ~5-person team plus freelancers; father manages finances/legal; mother develops story ideas; some videos take up to 4 months and involve hired decorators, film crew, writers, and professional actors.
    Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kids_Diana_Show; https://www.businessinsider.com/meet-youtube-family-behind-kids-diana-show-channel-2022-8; https://variety.com/2020/digital/news/kids-diana-show-pocketwatch-love-diana-show-1234608487/; https://awario.com/help/influencers/kids-diana-show/

(3) Channel Creation Date & Earliest Still-Public Upload

  • Channel created: May 12, 2015 (confirmed by multiple trackers).
  • Earliest still-public upload: '✿ VLOG Диана, приветствие! Greetings! Diana show first video on new channel' (https://youtu.be/h1_00oAj72c), uploaded May 12, 2015, ~1.99M views. It is a short (~1:28) introductory vlog in Russian.
    Sources: https://channelspikes.com/channel/kidsdianashow?sort=oldest&spikes=false; https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h1_00oAj72c; https://insidecreateurs.com/en/channels/kids-diana-show

(4) Operating Location & Displayed Country

  • Origin: Kyiv, Ukraine (family born/lived there; first videos filmed there in 2015).
  • Timeline: Ukraine (2015–2017/18) → Miami, Florida, USA (2018–2019) → Dubai, United Arab Emirates (2019–present).
  • The channel appears registered in the US per one analytics source, but the family currently resides in Dubai. The claim that the channel was 'originally Russia' is not supported: the family is Ukrainian (from Kyiv), though they spoke Russian as their first language and targeted Russian-speaking audiences initially.
    Sources: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kids_Diana_Show; https://www.businessinsider.com/meet-youtube-family-behind-kids-diana-show-channel-2022-8; https://scroll.media/en/2025/06/09/kids-diana-show-top-10-youtube-channel/; https://insidecreateurs.com/en/channels/kids-diana-show

(5) Languages

  • Primary language of the main channel: English (the family shifted to English captioning and on-screen speech starting in 2018 to target a global audience).
  • Original language (2015–2016): Russian.
  • The brand operates ~20 multilingual mirror/sister channels (Spanish, Hindi, Indonesian, Portuguese, Japanese, Arabic, Chinese, German, Vietnamese, Ukrainian, etc.) with dubbed or re-edited content.
    Sources: https://www.businessinsider.com/meet-youtube-family-behind-kids-diana-show-channel-2022-8; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kids_Diana_Show; https://scroll.media/en/2025/06/09/kids-diana-show-top-10-youtube-channel/

(6) Primary Content Category

  • Children's entertainment: pretend-play skits, family vlogs, toy unboxings, roleplay adventures, educational content, nursery rhymes/music videos.
    Sources: https://youtube.fandom.com/wiki/%E2%9C%BF_Kids_Diana_Show; https://awario.com/help/influencers/kids-diana-show/

(7) Content Supply Model

  • Family-produced original content, professionalized over time: filmed typically Tuesdays & Thursdays (~3 hrs/session); mother conceives stories; father handles business; hired crew/writers/actors/decorators for complex videos; some videos take up to 4 months to complete.
  • Multi-platform distribution: main channel + ~20 language-specific mirror channels; content licensed to OTT (Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, Roku Channel, Samsung TV+) via Pocket.Watch.
  • Revenue streams: YouTube ad revenue, brand advertising partnerships, merchandise licensing ('Love, Diana' line at Walmart and other retailers), mobile gaming.
    Sources: https://www.businessinsider.com/meet-youtube-family-behind-kids-diana-show-channel-2022-8; https://variety.com/2020/digital/news/kids-diana-show-pocketwatch-love-diana-show-1234608487/; https://scroll.media/en/2025/06/09/kids-diana-show-top-10-youtube-channel/

(8) Representative Series

  • 'Love, Diana' — Live-action/animated hybrid series (55 episodes across 2 seasons, aired Sep 2020–Dec 2021), set in the 'Land of Play' where Diana and Roma battle 'Boris the Bore'; distributed on YouTube, Amazon Prime Video, Hulu, Roku, Samsung TV+.
  • 'Kids Diana Show Ultimate Mishmash' — Compilation series on Hulu featuring edited clips from the main channel.
  • Main-channel recurring formats: pretend-play adventure compilations (e.g., 'Diana and Roma Escape Room,' 'Diana and Roma Playhouse Adventures'), school/vlog episodes, music videos ('LIKE IT,' 'Play It Be It').
    Sources: https://ngcp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_Love,_Diana_episodes; https://www.tubefilter.com/2023/05/03/pocket-watch-love-kids-diana-show-roma-hulu/; https://www.primevideo.com/detail/0IZKA15O3J83JJMPTVRZYIC499

Note on task-context discrepancy: The orchestrator described operators as 'Russian creators' and asked whether the displayed country was 'originally Russia, now USA?'. Evidence consistently shows the family is Ukrainian (born in Kyiv, Ukraine), spoke Russian as their first language, moved to Miami (USA) briefly in 2018–2019, and now resides in Dubai, UAE. There is no evidence the channel ever officially displayed Russia as its country; it appears registered in the US per one tracker, but the family does not currently live in the USA.
